entries.name: Walk-In Vertical Jump — step-close takeoff
entries.instruction: Main conversion of a slow forward entry into an organized upward two-foot push. Recovery: 90 s between complete set rounds; 15 s between individual reps; 90 s before the next exercise/section Use instead: a stationary countermovement vertical jump at the same remaining dose if the entry disrupts plant or receiving control; log removed entry steps. Low kicks are noncontact and below hip height, with active recoil and no knee snap or spin; qualify kicking competence during the prescribed first attempts.
